newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch call money nudges up ahead of the weekend.
newsitem.headline: Dutch call money nudges up ahead of the weekend.

text.p: Dutch money market rates lingered near yesterday's level with only call money rising a touch ahead of the weekend.
Dealers said that this morning's allocation of 2.83 billion guilders to the money market under a seven-day advances pact at an unchanged rate of 2.90 percent was sufficient.
Individual banks received 10.7 percent of the amount they had applied for, with the central bank setting a ceiling of 3.5 billion guilders on applications.
Business was mainly focused on call money and dealers said overall trade was thin.
Call money was bid between 3.06-12 percent from 3.00-06 on Thursday.
The guilder was fractionally stronger versus yesterday's close trading at 112.4975 per 100 marks from 112.505 on Thursday.
